result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but one card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a broken/missing image placeholder instead of an actual restaurant photo.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a gray broken-image placeholder icon instead of an actual restaurant/food image, while surrounding cards (e.g., the pizza card below) load images correctly.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source for this card (correct URL/asset path) or provide a branded fallback image so the card does not show a broken-image glyph.
